@graph.headline: Built Is Not Enough: How Metro Detroit Businesses Turn a Real Website Into Pipeline
@graph.description: The median small business website converts at just 2.9% of visitors. Here's the conversion playbook Metro Detroit businesses need after they upgrade from a landing page — speed, above-the-fold design, form length, local SEO, and the AI search shift.

about.name: Website Conversion Strategy for Small Businesses

mainEntity.name: What is a good conversion rate for a small business website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The median small business website converts about 2.9% of visitors into leads. Landing pages built for paid campaigns average 6.6%, and top-quartile pages exceed 11.45%. A realistic near-term goal for a local business site is 5-8% — then keep climbing.

mainEntity.name: Is a landing page better than a full website?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the job. A landing page wins for paid traffic aimed at one specific offer — one page, one action. A full website wins for organic search, brand building, and AI search citations, because multi-page depth is what search engines and AI assistants rank and quote. Most growing businesses need both: a real site plus dedicated landing pages for ads.

mainEntity.name: How much does page speed affect website conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every second of load time beyond about 2.5 seconds cuts conversions by roughly 7%. Pages that load in under 1.5 seconds convert 2.4x better than pages at 4 seconds, and bounce rates climb 32% between 1-second and 3-second loads. Speed is also a Google ranking factor, so it compounds.

mainEntity.name: How many fields should a website contact form have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three. Three-field forms convert at 10.1% while nine-field forms drop to 3.6%. Collect only what you need to route the lead, and qualify further in the follow-up. Requiring a phone number as a field costs about 5% of conversions on average.

mainEntity.name: How does local SEO help a Metro Detroit business get leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: 87% of consumers use Google to evaluate local businesses, and a complete Google Business Profile makes them 2.7x more likely to consider you reputable and 70% more likely to visit. Consistent name, address, and phone across listings adds a 31% SEO boost, and 87% of consumers read online reviews before choosing.

mainEntity.name: How do AI search engines like ChatGPT affect small business websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI assistants build answers from pages with depth, structure, and authority. Multi-page sites with clear headings, FAQs, and schema markup get cited; single landing pages rarely do. Businesses that want to be recommended by AI search in 2026 need a real website, not a one-pager.
